+
+Multitool owns the text of the skill, because it owns the `sessions` tool. ACPAgent reads the folder of the skill as the built-in layer of its skills stack, so ACPAgent waits on `BuiltinSkills.directory`.

+Precondition: the skill names the forms of D199 and the short id and the slug in `list sessions`. Thus it depends on ^grjj9r4 (short id, slug), ^6xznegm (address reader) and ^kewpex (the `id` of each change operation takes a short id and `@<slug>`).
+
+## Current behavior
+
+- The library target has no resources (`Package.swift:631-641`).
+- The pattern to copy: FoundationModelsKanban keeps its skill at `Documentation/kanban/SKILL.md`, and `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/KanbanSkillTests.swift:9-40` checks the frontmatter keys and runs each example against the tool.
+
+## Work
+
+- Add `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Resources/skills/sessions/SKILL.md` with the draft text, and `resources: [.copy("Resources/skills")]` on the library target. The folder `skills/` is one layer root: each child folder is one skill.
+- Edit the text as the tool requires, in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Keep it short: the agent reads it at each session start.
+- Add a public API, for example `public enum BuiltinSkills { public static var directory: URL }`, that gives `Bundle.module.url(forResource: "skills", withExtension: nil)`.
+- The receipt words `delivered`, `queued`, `refused` and `started` are the same in the tool (`SessionsToolText+Messages.swift:120-134`), in the endpoint and in the skill.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] The resource is in the bundle, and `BuiltinSkills.directory` holds `sessions/SKILL.md`.
+- [ ] The frontmatter has `name: sessions` and a `description`.
+- [ ] Each `{"op": "..."}` example of the skill decodes to an operation of `SessionsTool`, and each key of the example is a parameter or an alias of that operation.
+- [ ] Each code-mode verb that the skill names (for example `tools.sessions.sendMessage`, `tools.sessions.listSessions`) is a verb of the tool.
+- [ ] The skill names each of the forms `@<id>`, `@<short id>` and `@<slug>`, and each receipt word of the tool.
+- [ ] The existing session tool tests stay green.
